headline: Visa, Mastercard launch Open Standard stablecoin with Coinbase
summary: A consortium of businesses led by Visa, Mastercard and Coinbase have launched a joint stablecoin called Open Standard, tied to the US dollar.
details: The venture, called Open Standard, aims to accelerate global usage of stablecoins. Over 140 businesses are involved in the stablecoin network.

The coin, called Open USD, is tied to the US dollar and expected to be available later this year. Existing stablecoins have great strengths, but to use them at scale, businesses need something that's open, low-cost, high-throughput, broadly accessible and aligned to their interests.

This follows the introduction of PayPal's stablecoin, PayPal USD, which has remained relatively stable since launching back in 2023. President Trump recently signed the GENIUS Act into law, creating a regulatory framework for stablecoins.
